supporting_pages.title: Set up Application Integration \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Ways to set up Application Integration You can setup Application Integration in your Google Cloud project using the following ways: Quick setup The Quick setup is a single-click automated process that provisions Application Integration without you having to worry about any setup configurations.
Start Quick setup The Quick setup is a single-click operation that automatically provisions Application Integration with the default configurations needed to get you started with the product.
To start the Quick setup , do the following: Open the Google Cloud console and log in with your Google Cloud account.
